_doc: AU-01 Mastermind narrator lines keyed by event. Host plays a random line per event (pre-generated mp3 via scripts/gen-voice.sh, Web Speech fallback). 'named' lines (max 8) have a {name} slot and go through /api/tts.

lines.text: Good evening, crew. I am the Mastermind. Tonight we rob a bank. Try not to rob each other. Actually, do.
Phones out, keys on the table. The vault opens now.
Welcome to the heist of the century. Or at least of the evening.
Three.
Two.
One.
Go go go!
Crack it!
Next job. Same bank. Fewer friends.
New round, new locks. Faster this time.
Gloves on. The alarm clock is ticking.
Here comes the next vault. Don't fumble it.
The guards changed shifts. Move!
Break-in round. Keys are live. Guard your pockets.
Break-in! Anyone could be a thief. Especially you.
Hack round. No stealing, bigger payouts. Type fast.
Hack round! The firewall is thin and the cash is fat.
Rival heist. Two crooks, one vault. Everyone else: grab popcorn.
It's a showdown. Winner takes most of the pot.
STEAL! Grab someone's key and scan it!
Steal window! Scan a rival key, now!
Pickpocket time! Scan a key!
Clean lift. Somebody's wallet just got lighter.
Robbed! And in front of everyone.
Smooth. Very smooth. I'm almost proud.
Blocked! A shield ate that steal.
Nice try. That wallet was a decoy.
FREEZE! Hands off your phone!
Freeze! Nobody move a finger!
Statues, everyone. Freeze!
And... relax.
You may resume your crimes.
BANK RAID! Smash that grab button!
The vault door is open! Grab the cash!
A quarter of the bank is gone. They'll notice soon.
Seventy five percent left. Keep it quiet.
Half the bank is gone. Sirens are warming up.
Fifty percent left. Start thinking about the exit.
Only a quarter left. This is getting dangerous.
Twenty five percent. The cops are on their way.
The bank is empty! Everybody run!
Nothing left to steal. Escape, escape, escape!
ESCAPE! Tap to bank your cash before the doors lock!
The alarm is blaring! Escape now or lose it all!
Run! Unbanked cash stays behind!
Ooh. That's going on the highlight reel.
Sloppy. Very sloppy.
The vault laughs at you.
Butterfingers.
And that, crew, is how you get caught.
Let's count the loot.
Time to see who's been naughty and who's been rich.
Catch your breath. Draw a card if you dare.
Short break. Plot your revenge.
Two challengers enter. One leaves richer.
We have a winner of the showdown!
The rival heist is over. The loser pays.
Hacker versus hacker! Someone just got the scramble button.
A rogue hacker is loose in the system.
Signal jammed! Good luck reading that.
Scrambled! Somebody's having a bad time.
The heist is over. We have our mastermind.
Pack it up. The richest crook wins.
Waiting for the crew. Scan in when you're ready.
Join with the code on screen. Don't be shy, thief.

named.text: {name} takes the crown. And all the money.
Congratulations, {name}. The cleanest getaway of the night.
Somebody check on {name}. That lock won.
{name} has the scramble button. Be afraid.
{name} is out the door with the cash!
